name: Si Zhe Huan Yang
source:
A Chinese occult text adventure game - the player plays the role of "I", who is dying of the disease, and in a trance, is drawn to a black and white world. Here, "I" meets five other people who come here for different reasons.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3464610]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一款中国玄幻文字冒险游戏——玩家扮演因病濒临死亡的“我”，恍惚间被吸入黑白世界。在这里，“我”遇到了另外五个因不同原因来到这里的人。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3464610]Steam[/url]]
